caption:
Episode 1. Six people, one group chat, zero decisions.

Hamza will say "kahin bhi" and then reject everything. Anum wants to know the portion. Zain needs a pic. Sara orders last and copies you. Ali bhai knows the owner (he doesn't).

Khana kahan? New episode every week. Tag your Hamza.
alt_text: A made-up group chat where six friends can't decide where to eat.
slide_headlines: Friday, 7:52 pm. | 9:40 pm. Still in the car park.

caption:
Anum is the portion police and honestly she has a point.

"Sharing platter" can mean anything from four fries to a whole wooden board. On a MENVA menu she just places it on the table and checks.

Slide 2 is the actual board, at true size. Sharing hai ya single? You decide.
alt_text: A chat about whether a board is for sharing, then the real steak board scan.
slide_headlines: Anum has questions. | This is "generous." Actual size.

caption:
Zain's whole personality is "pic bhejo".

The problem: the pic is from 2019, taken by someone's cousin, under a tube light. The plate you'll get tonight has never met that photo.

Pic pe mat jao. Plate dekho.
alt_text: A chat about an old menu photo, then a real scan of the steak sandwich.
slide_headlines: Zain wants proof. | The plate, tonight's version.

caption:
Sara has never ordered first. Not once. Not since 2017.

She waits, watches, then says "mera bhi wohi". Which is a strategy, actually. But imagine if she could see the plate herself.

Tag the Sara in your group. She'll reply last.
alt_text: A chat where one friend always copies everyone else's order.

caption:
Every group has an Ali bhai. "Trust me, main order karta hoon."

Then three plates arrive and nobody at the table knows which is which. Next time, bhai, just show us first.

Kaun hai tumhare group ka Ali bhai? Comment mein naam likho (pyaar se).
alt_text: A chat where one friend orders for everyone without saying what, then a real scan of the trio.
slide_headlines: Ali bhai has a plan. | The trio. Seen before it landed.

caption:
Hamza, Monday: "kal se diet."
Hamza, Friday, 9:52 pm: this.

We're not judging. We're just saying he saw it on the table first, so at least it was an informed decision.
alt_text: A chat where a friend on a diet orders the steak sandwich, then the real scan.
slide_headlines: Hamza's diet, day 4. | The salad. (Hamza's version.)

caption:
The friend with the bill spreadsheet deserves a medal and also a break.

We can't fix the split. We can fix the part before it: seeing what you're ordering, so nobody pays for a plate they didn't want.
alt_text: A joke receipt of a chaotic group dinner, with no prices.

caption:
Birthday dinner for 11 people is not a dinner. It's an operation.

Anum made a list. It's the most organised any of us has ever been. Save it for the next one.
alt_text: A notes-app plan for a birthday dinner for 11, then the show-the-waiter list on a phone.
slide_headlines: Sana's birthday. The plan. | Rule 5: one list. Show the waiter.

caption:
Plot twist: Mama is in the group now.

She has one question and it's the same question every Pakistani mother has asked since the dawn of restaurants.

Tag the friend whose mom would send this exact message.
alt_text: A family chat where a mother asks why so much food was ordered.

caption:
Exam season. Zain's budget is one main course and a prayer.

Which one fills you up? Don't guess. Look at them side by side at true size, then pick.

Comment A or B. Zain is reading.
alt_text: A chat about a student budget, then two real dishes side by side.
slide_headlines: Zain's budget week. | One main. Which one?

caption:
Eleven episodes. Hamza finally decided in under a minute.

What changed? He saw it on the table first. That's it. That's the whole twist.

Pehle dekho, phir order.
alt_text: A chat where the indecisive friend orders in a minute, then the brand line.
slide_headlines: Something changed. | Pehle dekho. Phir order.

caption:
Meanwhile, in a group chat you're not in.

Restaurant owners and managers: if your team explains the same platter all night, a 3D menu at the table does the explaining. They get to host.

Lahore pilot, PKR 25,000. DM "PILOT".
alt_text: A made-up restaurant staff chat about guests asking about portion size.
